request.style: English, intimate acoustic folk, clear female vocal, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, fiddle, harmonica, upright bass, gentle storytelling, 88 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
An expert in the law stood up
To test him in the crowd
Teacher, what must I do to live
He asked the question loud
Love God with all your heart and soul
Your neighbor as yourself
But who then is my neighbor, sir
He asked, to clear himself

[Chorus]
Who is my neighbor
Who will stop along the road
The one who showed him mercy
Go and do likewise
Go and do likewise

[Verse]
A man went down to Jericho
And robbers struck him down
They stripped him and they beat him there
And left him on the ground
A priest came by and saw him lie
And passed the other side
A Levite came and did the same
And left him there to die

[Verse]
But a Samaritan drew near
And saw him where he lay
And he was moved with compassion
He would not turn away
He bound his wounds with oil and wine
He set him on his own
And brought him to an inn and stayed
And did not leave him alone

[Chorus]
Who is my neighbor
Who will stop along the road
The one who showed him mercy
Go and do likewise
Go and do likewise

[Bridge]
Take care of him
And whatever more you spend
I will repay you when I return

[Outro]
Go and do likewise
